meta.name: migrate-slack-agents
meta.description: Migrate a classic single-bot Slack install to one provisioned Slack app per existing agent group while preserving agent identities, workspaces, memory, and wiring behavior — or record the operator's choice to stay on classic, which remains supported. Use when /update-nanoclaw surfaces the Slack agents requirement, or standalone any time later.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 迁移 Slack 机器人架构为每组独立应用，保留身份与记忆
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在使用经典 Slack 机器人并需按 agent 分组独立应用
copy.tagline_en: Migrate classic Slack bots to per-agent apps, preserving identities and memory
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run a classic Slack bot setup and need per-agent Slack apps

howto.what: 它把共用一个 Slack 机器人的安装,改成每个已有 agent 组各有一个名为 slack-<slug> 的机器人:先出对照表,逐个开通应用、重建频道与私聊接线,验证后由你确认切换。不新建 agent 组,也不改工作区文件。
howto.when: 当 /update-nanoclaw 提示 Slack 代理相关要求时自动出现,之后也可随时手动运行 /migrate-slack-agents;若检测不到经典单机器人状态则不做任何改动。

say.text: 帮我迁移 Slack 代理,先给我看对照表
say.note: 会列出 dry-run 映射表等你确认

say.text: 我不想迁移,继续用经典 Slack
say.note: 它只记录你的决定,不改任何配置

say.text: 继续,给每个代理组开通独立机器人
say.note: 逐个开通 slack-<slug> 应用

howto.what_en: Migrates a classic single-bot Slack setup to one provisioned slack-<slug> bot per agent group: dry-run map, provisioning, recreated channels/DMs, verification, then cutover confirmation. Never creates agent groups or edits workspaces.
howto.when_en: Triggers when /update-nanoclaw surfaces the Slack agents requirement, or when you run /migrate-slack-agents later. With no classic single-bot state detected, it makes no changes.

say_en.text: Migrate my Slack agents and show me the dry-run map first
say_en.note: Lists the proposed mapping, waits for your OK

say_en.text: I'll stay on classic Slack, don't migrate
Continue and provision a bot per agent group
say_en.note: Creates one slack-<slug> app per group
